name: KingbaseES
minimum_privileges: USAGE AND CREATE ON TEST SCHEMA

privilege_checks.privilege: USAGE AND CREATE ON TEST SCHEMA

qualification.scope: Only the observed combination: server V009R002C016, database_mode=oracle, JDBC database version 12.1, driver declaration V008R006B0001. Limited trials, not full CORE qualification; other builds and modes unqualified. See docs/execution-safety.md#kingbasees-candidate-observations.
qualification.timeout_note: The initial CORE run exhausted its shared Worker execution and cleanup budget. Narrow reproduction observed a costly initial getTypeInfo call and the original scenario completed in isolation. No full CORE pass or platform, driver or database defect established. Detailed reports remain local; no global timeout, scenario skipping policy or capability gate changed to hide the result.
qualification.capability_policy: Booleans are scenario execution gates. True enables candidate assessment, not a compatibility guarantee. False disables unqualified scenarios, not a finding of missing database support.
qualification.asset_policy: PostgreSQL assets are trial inputs for the scoped JDBC scenarios, not a claim that all PostgreSQL SQL is compatible. Callable, array, LOB, XML and rowset groups remain disabled.
qualification.version_policy: No supported version interval asserted. JDBC database version 12.1, server build V009R002C016, Manifest/metadata driver version V008R006B0001 and Driver major/minor 0.0 are distinct observations.
